fact: The INS quarterly foreign trade bulletin for Q4 2025 (No. 01, March 2026) states its figures come from customs declarations entered in SYDONIA by the Customs Directorate and processed by INS with EUROTRACE, and that the data have been drawn from customs declarations since 1991.
title: Bulletin des statistiques du commerce extérieur du quatrième (4ème) trimestre 2025
